{{Location_Infobox |title = Riccioli Islands |image = Riccioli Islands.jpg |map = Solaris-3 |type = Region |nation = Rinascita }} The {{Intro/Location|Riccioli Islands}} It is a group of islands northwest of Ragunna, rich in various marine resources. Falling out of the governance of the Order of the Deep, these islands have preserved the customs from Rinascita's Age of a Thousand Islands era, setting them apart from the rest of Ragunna in lifestyle.
